name: Put/Call + VIX confluence capitulation buy-the-fear long on SPY/QQQ
rationale: Thesis: equity put/call-ratio extremes mark hedging capitulation and have historically flagged attractive short-term LONG entries, and the signal is materially stronger when CONFIRMED by a coincident VIX spike (both gauges confirm genuine panic, not noise) (QuantifiedStrategies, MenthorQ, ValueTrend, Britannica). We trade this as a CONFLUENCE composite (putcall_ratio AND vix_level fearful together) rather than the already-exhausted VIX-alone or Fear&Greed-alone single-gauge capitulation trade. A third, optional confirmation requires bb_z very negative (price statistically washed-out) so we are buying an actual flush, not merely elevated hedging inside an uptrend. Hedge-fund-ignored angle: a tactical, low-frequency dip-buy on broad index/sector ETFs (SPY/QQQ + sector ETFs, no shorting, no single-name selection) is too small/slow for a vol desk but a clean long-only swing entry for us; the putcall+VIX panic signal is index-wide so it arms the whole ETF set uniformly, not just SPY/QQQ. Both inputs are BOUNDED (putcall_ratio z-score; vix_level ~10-80), so the fitted thresholds genuinely bind. Disconfirmer 1 (does confluence beat its best single leg?): the putcall-alone and vix-alone capitulation specs are in the cohort — if either single signal matches this confluence, the second leg is redundant and this collapses to the FAILED VIX-alone/F&G-alone fear-buy; the confluence MUST add deflated-Sharpe over the better single leg or it is over-fitting two filters. Disconfirmer 2 (timing vs exposure): the timed entries must beat buy-and-hold over the same in-market days net of fees — the fear-timing, not merely being long, has to pay. Disconfirmer 3 (PIT honesty): putcall_ratio is read at its CBOE next-day-availability floor so we never peek at the same-day close. The deterministic Gate disposes; an honest FAIL is valid.
catalyst: putcall_ratio crosses above an extreme z-score AND VIX spikes above a fitted level on the same/adjacent bar (joint panic confirmation)
